title: House Tomato - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Windowsill Indoor Dwarf Tomato - Rare
description:
You will receive 2 healthy mini House Tomato plug plants.


 A charming and unusual Russian heirloom variety, later introduced to Canada in the 1890s. This compact dwarf tomato has been specially bred for growing in pots indoors, making it perfect for a sunny windowsill, patio or balcony.


 House Tomato grows into a short, sturdy bush of around 1ft tall and produces masses of round red cherry tomatoes with classic tomato flavour. It is very early, vigorous and reliable, often beginning to flower while still in a small nursery pot.


 Ideal for:


  Windowsills
 

  Conservatories
 

  Patios
 

  Balconies
 

  Indoor pot growing
 

 Key features:


  2 x mini plug plants
 

  Heirloom Russian variety
 

  Compact dwarf habit, around 1ft tall
 

  Heavy cropping cherry tomato plant
 

  Perfect for pots and indoor growing
 

  Early flowering and very productive
 

  Can be overwintered indoors
 

 Growing notes:
 

 Grow in a pot in a bright, sunny spot. This variety is traditionally grown indoors and can be cut back when brought inside in autumn. With sufficient light, it can continue producing tomatoes through winter. A bright south-facing window is often enough.


 A wonderful choice if you want a productive tomato plant that looks great and thrives as a houseplant.
